plan: OpenVibe End-to-End Realignment & Implementation Plan, revision 3 (20 Sep 2026)
deployment: Deployed in shadow on openvibe-ovh: /opt/openvibe.billing (release b59725e), unit openvibe-billing, API on 127.0.0.1:4600 (loopback only; /api/v1 is denied on the public host). Public at https://billing.openvibe.network: the staff console (Network SSO + PKCE, BILLING_STAFF_SUBJECTS = the owner only), /api/health and /webhooks/*. No provider secret is configured, so every provider is off and /webhooks/* answers 404 billing.provider_disabled. Pins openvibe-contracts v0.19.0.
notes: Runtime, journal, adapters, import, reconciliation and the staff console (cashout approve/deny, review queue, reconciliation, freeze, audit log) are built and tested. Capabilities (8 billing.*) and events are registered in OpenVibe.Contracts (v0.8.0; billing.staff.action in v0.17.0). Production holds a shadow import of a Live snapshot (322 transactions: 304 imported plus 18 opening adjustments; 3 reconciliation runs, the last 2026-09-23 01:21 UTC, all checks ok), 0 subscriptions and 0 entitlements; the console has never been used (staff_audit 0). The restore drill passed on the host 2026-09-23 05:22 UTC. The Live side (Billing client behind BILLING_AUTHORITY, money freeze) is deployed in Live since c384787, but BILLING_AUTHORITY is not set in live.env, so Live stays the money authority. The cutover (README runbook, docs/live-cutover.md) has not been executed: it waits on the owner putting the PowerChat secret in billing.env and re-pointing the PowerChat webhook to https://billing.openvibe.network/webhooks/powerchat. Built, not yet deployed (after b59725e): /metrics (openvibe-shared v1.3.0, loopback only); hourly scheduled reconciliation stored with its trigger and exposed at GET /api/v1/admin/reconciliations, in the console and on /metrics, with ledger-vs-receipt checks (receipts.ledger, receipts.external, receipts.stale); EXTERNAL PowerChat tips stored in external_receipts and announced as billing.receipt.external under BILLING_AUTHORITY=billing (default live: recorded only), attributed through provider_accounts (imported from Live's powerchat_connections), consumed by OpenVibe.Tips 6d14574; overflow guards (safe integers in the journal, $1M per receipt); settlement under an IMMEDIATE transaction (multi-process races settle once without lock errors). billing.receipt.external is not yet in an openvibe-contracts release. Live's payouts, refunds and plans have no tables of their own; where they map is docs/live-mapping.md.
